correctness.rationale: For each finite K, the 2K-site dependency blocks partition Z; each observation R^t f(2Kq+s) uses only its assigned block for t<K. In the displayed alternating coordinate order the time-t pair introduces f(-t),f(t+1), each with diagonal 2^(-t), giving determinant 2^(-K(K-1)). The Laurent Chebyshev identity 2 T_j(R)f(n)=f(n-j)+f(n+j) reconstructs all coordinates. The alternating coefficient l1 norm is |T_j(i)|=(alpha^j+(-1)^j alpha^(-j))/2 for alpha=1+sqrt(2), bounding the inverse norm above by polynomial(K)alpha^K and below by alpha^(K-1)/sqrt(K); ||H_K|| lies between 1 and sqrt(2K). Therefore the Kth-root condition number tends to alpha for all positive K, while the frame ratio root is alpha^2. Independently implemented exact Fraction elimination on H_K for K=1..7 and confirmed the determinants; script source was also inspected. These tests are ancillary; the triangularity and Chebyshev proof supply the all-K result.
